title: fastverify API Result Envelope v1
description: Stable, versioned JSON contract emitted by bin/fv, fastverify-mcp, fvapi HTTP REST API, fv watch, and fastverify-action across project verification, single/batch attempt verification, export-in checks, and conditional frontier checks.

accepted.description: True if and only if verdict == 'ACCEPTED' AND trust is one of 'sound', 'sound-conditional', 'notary' (full unconditional sound acceptance; Z03-4). An ACCEPTED under trust 'UNSAFE', 'exact-by-design (unofficial)', 'official', 'conditional' or 'none' is reported but sets accepted=false. Conditional, declined, error, and no-verdict outcomes ALWAYS set accepted=false.

reward.description: Reward-safe scalar for RL and automated search loops: 1.0 iff accepted (verdict == 'ACCEPTED' with a sound-family trust), strictly 0.0 otherwise (incl. an ACCEPTED under a non-sound trust, REJECTED, CONDITIONAL, DECLINED, NO-VERDICT, ERROR, PENDING).

exit_code.description: 0 = accepted (ACCEPTED with a sound-family trust), 1 = REJECTED, 2 = DECLINED/NO-VERDICT/ERROR or an ACCEPTED under a non-sound trust, 3 = CONDITIONAL.

soundness.description: Trusted-base provenance: challenge pin status, checker version and binary sha256s, untrusted build transforms.

frontier.description: Populated when conditional sorry-frontier verification ran: listed frontier theorems, remaining count, hidden sorries.

statement_audit.description: Populated when statement fidelity audit ran: non-Mathlib reading set size, lints, vacuity probe warnings.

raw.description: Underlying backend payload (fastverify result.json, fvserve response, or check-sound JSON).
